subject: Post-demo: Obligato compliance checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Carter <samantha.carter@obligato.ai>, Obligato Procurement <procurement@obligato.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Obligato compliance checklist & next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Scope: you flagged GDPR + HIPAA as likely in-scope for the pilot (customer data; EU residency for a subset).
- Security artifacts you asked for: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter/interim attestation, vendor security questionnaire (DSQ).
- Access: trust portal access for your security team (preferred) and SFTP fallback if needed.

Can you confirm the names/emails for the security reviewers and procurement contact we should provision in the portal? If HIPAA is required, confirm whether Business Associate Agreement (BAA) will be part of the legal review — we can route that to Legal (cc Laura).

Proposed timeline: portal account within 1-3 business days after we receive reviewer emails; SOC 2 Type II summary and bridge letter (draft) we can share within 24 hours of this note; full report delivery on request (NDA/portal acceptance usually required).

Next steps: please send the primary point for security review + procurement contact and we’ll provision access and upload the initial artifacts.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I’ve created a pending invite for samantha.carter@obligato.ai and raj.patel@obligato.ai; you should see an email from trust@redwood.ai shortly. 4) Timeline: portal invites sent today; SOC2 summary & bridge draft (attached) — immediate; full report/official delivery once procurement/legal confirm access and confidentiality terms (usually 3-5 business days depending on signatures).

Next step items for Obligato: confirm whether you want SAML or email invites, and confirm procurement contact Erin Moore for PO/contract routing.

- We will review the DSQ and aim to return a completed first-pass within 48 hours.
- Please mark HIPAA explicitly as in-scope in the bridge letter (we need that for Legal).
- Procurement (Erin) asked whether Redwood can accept a PO via DocuSign — if so, please send a PO/contract DocuSign link once Legal gives the green light.
